main.description: ADR-0051. Persist Tier 3 PII payload (signal:v1: encrypted) for a draft declaration. Form data only; no state transition until reviewed.

applicantPayload.description: signal:v1: encrypted JSON of applicant section.

spousePayload.description: signal:v1: encrypted JSON of spouse section. Optional.

dependentsPayload.description: signal:v1: encrypted JSON array of >=16 dependents.

minorDependentsPayload.description: signal:v1: encrypted JSON array of <16 dependents.

specialStatusPayload.description: signal:v1: encrypted JSON of disability/widow/single-parent flags.

declarationHash.description: sha256 of canonical PII payload, mirrored to Tier 1.
